card.name: Pesticide and herbicide name lists
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside lists of pesticide or herbicide names, such as commas and parts of names like acetochlor, dioxin and 2,4-D. It also fires on the word herbicides itself.

modes.label: Inside herbicide names
modes.description: Partway through a herbicide name or just after the word herbicide(s).
modes.example: insecticides-carbaryl, chlorpyrifos, diazinon, endosulfan, and malathion-and five herbicides<<-ac>>etochlor, atrazine, glyph

modes.label: Commas in chemical lists
modes.description: Commas, spaces or 'and' between named pesticides in a list.
modes.example: endosulfan, and malathion-and five herbicides-acetochlor<<,>> atrazine, glyphosate, metol

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are programming terms (bundle, property, JS) and do not fit this text, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up in lists of pesticide and herbicide names, on the names and the commas between them.
